Walmart tips:

Always look for the brand “Great Value” as that will usually be the cheapest option which often for food items and some other things like toilet paper.

For today, I would suggest buying the essentials like pillow, sheets(if you didn’t bring them), personal care items like soap, shampoo, toothpaste if you didn’t bring them. Also toilet paper, laundry soap and dryer sheets for the dryer. I will send photos of those items in the group once I get to Walmart so check WhatsApp and connect to Walmart wifi.

Then also buy some food items at least for your first week but not too much until you can see what you will use. Some suggestions: milk, eggs, bread, fruit, vegetables, cheese, ham, butter or oil for cooking, any snacks.
Feel free to ask me any questions while you’re shopping and I’ll try to check my phone often☺️
Here the “How to” videos ☺️
Also, you can drink water from the sink
And you can put toilet paper in the toilet and not the trash can.

Good morning everyone! If you received the email “Human Subject Pool System” please forward it as an attachment to spamreport@wichita.edu 

Here is how to send as an attachment:

    To forward an email as an attachment from the Outlook client on Windows:
 
    1.With the email selected or open, look on the Home tab on the Ribbon for the Respond section (Reply, Reply All, etc.).
    2.Click on the “More” button.
    3.Select “Forward as attachment”. Enter the “spamreport@wichita.edu” address in the “to” field, and hit send.
 
    To forward an email as an attachment from the Outlook client on the Mac:
 
    1.With the email selected or open, look on the Ribbon for the (Reply, Reply All, etc.) section.
    2.Click on the “Attachment button.
    3.Enter the “spamreport@wichita.edu” address in the “to” field, and hit send.

Estas sesiones tienen como objetivo impartir los conocimientos adquiridos en Estados Unidos a nuestra comunidad 🇵🇾 a través de una serie de webinars que se realizan de manera virtual, una vez al mes donde diferentes becarios disertan sobre temas desarrollados en sus clases tomadas en Estados Unidos o temas relevantes al intercambio/ estudio en EEUU.
Este es formulario para hacer la presentación: https://forms.gle/SARkLQmPfzauVwpu8

If anyone needs ideas for topics, just let me know. More than one student can also work together on doing a presentation especially if you took the same class at WSU. I’m also happy to help in anyway that I can so please don’t hesitate to reach out to me too. This is one opportunity for BECAL students to share what they learned from their experience in Kansas☺️ and give back to others for the scholarship that you all received.
